stem:
Students place a toy elephant on the floor in a room without windows. The students turn the room's light on and off and record their observations in the table.

| Light | Observation         |
|-------|---------------------|
| On    | Can see the toy     |
| Off   | Cannot see the toy  |

Which statement describes the conditions that allow the students to see the toy?

options.label: A
options.text: Light rays reflect off the toy and travel to the lightbulb.

options.label: B
options.text: Light rays reflect off the toy and travel to the students’ eyes.

options.label: C
options.text: Light rays refract off the toy and travel to the lightbulb.

options.label: D
options.text: Light rays refract off the toy and travel to the students’ eyes.

visual_elements: table with Light and Observation columns showing On = Can see the toy, Off = Cannot see the toy
